subject: Coordination: Azure Marketplace co-sell demo — sequencing & Ops runbook
messages:
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-15T08:22:00+01:00
Subject: Coordination: Azure Marketplace co-sell demo — sequencing & Ops runbook

Team —

We need to lock the run order and ownership before I reach out to CloudWave / Siemens. Key constraints: EU CET schedule (partner is Germany-based), we want a 60-minute joint demo + 15min post-demo Q&A, and a 15-minute pre-call (technical handoff) 30 minutes before the main session.

Proposed agenda (attached: azure-marketplace-demo-agenda.pdf):
- 00:00–05:00: Quick intros & outcomes
- 05:00–25:00: Redwood platform overview (lead: Sales/SI)
- 25:00–45:00: Live walkthrough (lead: Product/Tech) — focus on private deployment + VPC use case
- 45:00–60:00: Marketplace listing & procurement flow (lead: Partnerships)
- 60:00–75:00: Q&A and next steps

Questions / asks:
1) Karhik, can you take the live walkthrough (architecture + on-prem demo) if I own intros and procurement flow?
2) Marissa, can Partnerships own the marketplace listing section and confirm who from legal we should loop for the small T&C question (data residency checkbox)?
3) Availability windows to propose to partner (CET):
   - Wed 17 Nov: 09:30–11:00 or 14:00–15:30
   - Thu 18 Nov: 10:00–11:30 or 15:30–17:00

I need to send the partner outreach by 09:30 CET today, so please reply with ownership and any objections by 08:45. Attaching the draft agenda and the Siemens pre-demo checklist we should confirm with partner.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: azure-marketplace-demo-agenda.pdf, siemens-pre-demo-checklist.xlsx

Hi Oliver / CloudWave team —

Thanks for agreeing to a joint demo. We propose a 60-minute co-sell session covering: brief outcomes, Redwood platform demo (private/VPC), live walkthrough of deployment patterns, and the Azure Marketplace procurement flow. I’ve attached a one-page agenda and a pre-demo checklist for Siemens.

Proposed CET slots (please confirm which works for your team):
- Wed 17 Nov: 09:30–10:30 CET (preferred)
- Wed 17 Nov: 14:00–15:00 CET
- Thu 18 Nov: 10:00–11:00 CET
- Thu 18 Nov: 15:30–16:30 CET

We also request a 15-minute technical pre-call 30 minutes before the demo to confirm environment access and screen-sharing permissions. If you need us to send an invite we can — otherwise please send calendar hold.

Quick asks for the pre-call:
- Confirm an account with console access for the demo (read-only is fine)
- Any IPs that need to be whitelisted for telemetry during the demo
- Who will present the procurement / marketplace overview from your side (we want to align the listing steps)

Calendly link if easier: https://calendly.com/jasmine-liu/azure-marketplace-demo

Look forward to hearing which slot works and whether the pre-call is OK.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
